summary.title: Northstar Cloud AI assistant
summary.description: Northstar uses a shared vector index for its cloud-based support assistant. Employees upload customer PDF files through the portal. These PDF files are treated as untrusted. An external large language model (LLM) receives questions and selected passages. Tool credentials are stored within the gateway. Employee approval is required before sending emails or creating support tickets. The support ticket and email services are located outside the application boundary. Specific access controls, approval checks, and audit settings are not specified.

threats.title: PDF processing delays other tenants
threats.description: Large PDF uploads may delay processing for other tenants
threats.mitigation: Limit upload size, processing time and concurrent tasks per tenant

data.name: Shared Vector Index
data.description: the index is shared by tenants.Documents have tenant IDs and access labels.Each tenant can only access authorized passages

threats.title: 1-Unauthorized retrieval
threats.description: Staff may access unauthorised documents, which may also be sent to the LLM
threats.mitigation: Check tenant and document permissions before retrieval and sending to the LLM

threats.title: pdf distorts draft
threats.description: Untrusted PDF content may cause incorrect summaries or drafts
threats.mitigation: Treat pdf text as untrusted and show sources for verification

threats.title: Unauthorised action
threats.description: The gateway may execute actions beyond the approved scope
threats.mitigation: Check permissions and ensure actions match the approval

threats.title: Acction cannot be traced to approver
threats.description: Audit logs may not show who approved an action
threats.mitigation: Record the approver time, and approved action in secure audit logs
